reading_source: All 234 authored sentences and accepted alternatives reviewed against the user-supplied word families. Every kanji annotated and lexical kana preserved. Contextual topic は→わ and object を→お explicitly marked during review. Katakana transliterated to hiragana with long vowels retained. 富士山=ふじさん, 三十分=さんじゅっぷん, 十時=じゅうじ, 濡れた=ぬれた, 嗅ぐ=かぐ, 収まる=おさまる. Returning family retains its previous reviewed inputs. Additional 264 grammar-family prompts and accepted variants reviewed with exact annotated readings and contextual particle pronunciation. 九時=くじ, 十時=じゅうじ, 三十分=さんじゅっぷん, 今日中=きょうじゅう, 納豆=なっとう. 着く=つく and 着る=きる; 話す=はなす and noun 話=はなし. Source examples adjusted where their grammar category did not match the original target. Third supplied set: 330 prompts across 28 additional families, plus accepted alternatives, checked with exact hiragana readings and contextual particles. Cooking readings include 出汁=だし, 鰹節=かつおぶし, 生姜=しょうが, 味噌=みそ, 醤油=しょうゆ, 柚子=ゆず, 揉む=もむ. 十分 (duration)=じゅっぷん, 百七十度=ひゃくななじゅうど. Giving/receiving examples retain their subject and beneficiary particles. 頼む example reworded from お願いして to 頼んで to match its answer button.
notes: Marin at generation speed 1.0 for all full sentences. Three source prompts per word; accepted alternatives have distinct lookup keys where needed. No audible listening or pitch-accent verification claimed.
